name: Randy Helvey
description: Discover, extract, build and log migrations in any Cendyn CMS module (rooms, offers, venues, events, blog, galleries, sections). Four skills: cendyn-discovery (maps a template into a reusable profile), cendyn-copy (extracts source copy with provenance tags), cendyn-page-builder (creates pages from profile + content) and migration-log (one living record per site). Includes shared profiles and worked examples.
